content:
The lean4web instance at https://live.lean-lang.org/ now also offers the latest nightly release of Lean. To use it, go to
https://live.lean-lang.org/#project=lean-nightly
or use the “Settings” in the top-right menu to switch lean versions. Comes without Batteries or Mathlib.

This is particularly useful if you want to report an issue, have created a #mwe, and want to quickly see if maybe the issue is already fixed in the latest development version of Lean.
